raw:
The 2014 Chinese Grand Prix was won by Lewis Hamilton, of Mercedes (the top-10 results list him first, ahead of Nico Rosberg, also Mercedes). The following season, 2015, Mercedes won 16 races, according to the 2015 constructors' standings.

The 2015 season standings list Hamilton with 10 wins and Rosberg with 6, which sums to 16.

ANSWER: 16
